rachel: Quick update  we're pausing tomorrow's release/train cutover. Canary showed a small but reproducible mismatch in quota-router header handling. No customer-facing errors yet.
tom: Understood. Pause only or roll back?
rachel: Pause. We'll push a defensive shim and re-run canary validation. If canary is green for 30m, we'll do a staged ramp.
sre-bot: incident logged: INC-4602 (quota-router header mismatch).
sam: I'll draft a short CS note: 'Cutover delayed; patch and validation in progress; ETA 2-3h for decision.'
ops: Set alert thresholds: latency +25% for 10m or error-rate >0.5% for 5m -> auto-rollback.
tom: Hotfix PR created and deploying to infra-canary-a now.
sre-bot: deploy-start tom/hotfix/header-shim -> infra-canary-a
tom: Canary results (snapshot): 1,000 synthetic reqs, 997 pass; failures tied to header-order.
rachel: Good. If canary >=99% over 30m, proceed 10% -> 50% -> full with 1h soaks. Tom owns ramps, Sam owns comms, Ops owns rollback.
sre-bot: ramp-event id=rv-901 pct=10 service=quota-router status=started
tom: 10% ramp 10m metrics: latency +3%, errors 0.07%. No alerts.
ops: CS update posted and status page annotated. Link: internal/INC-4602.
rachel: Thanks team. Keeping thread as single source of truth. Will post final go/no-go at the 1h checkpoint. :thumbsup:
